Adds native GRE6 and GRE6 over FOU using IPv6 endpoints, with IPv4 and IPv6 inner traffic. Both are available in the tunnel editor, CLI and existing plan workflows. Suggested MTUs are 1448 and 1440 respectively; existing tunnel defaults remain unchanged.

Update the server, frontend, CLI and both endpoint agents before using these types; their commands require protocol 11. Configure explicit local and remote IPv6 underlays. Linux `ip6_gre` support is required; FOU GRE6 also needs `fou6` and iproute2 with JSON support for `ip -j fou show`.

No new database migration or existing-plan rewrite is required.
